Replaced uniform dead-zone rounding with deterministic selection among neighboring integers, minimizing latent squared error under a budget derived from the frozen Gaussian CDFs. Trusted public evaluation passed the rate gate, improved DISTS, and reduced actual mean bitrate; the tested candidate remains in place.

Weighted neighboring-integer distortion costs by regularized, bounded inverse channel variance while preserving the existing CDF bitrate budget. Trusted public evaluation passed the bitrate gate and improved DISTS over the current best; the tested candidate remains in place.

Added channel mean and contrast penalties to the existing entropy-budgeted allocator, accepting reallocations only when the combined distortion objective improves. Trusted public evaluation passed the bitrate gate and improved DISTS over the current best; the tested candidate remains in place.

Added covariance-guided channel grouping and spatially staggered refinement, accepting updates only when the complete surrogate objective decreases within the existing CDF bit budget. Trusted public evaluation passed the bitrate gate but worsened DISTS relative to the current best; the tested candidate remains in place for controller selection.

Added opposite-sign integer candidates at zero baseline symbols, allowing covariance refinement to cancel coupled errors under the existing CDF bit budget. Trusted public evaluation passed the bitrate gate and matched the current best DISTS; the tested candidate remains in place.

Added bounded horizontal and vertical AR(1) precision terms over the compact prior lattice, incorporating spatially correlated quantization error into allocation and refinement. Trusted evaluation was valid and bitrate-compliant, but reconstruction quality worsened versus the retained best; the tested candidate remains in place.
